purpose: Add an isolated CLI-only read of live purchase/inbound ERP form, button and dropdown bindings with bounded fixed SQL and sanitized technical output; do not activate business commands
constraints: Admission candidate only; no implementation or actual DB calls have run. Root publishes immutable admission before implementation.
Root sole GitHub publisher; workers prepare bounded local files only.
Priority is live ERP configuration mappings, not SELECT 1 or schema-only qualification.

Exact menu/form filters and selected column names must be verified against committed source catalog and live metadata; unknown or changed shapes fail closed and are reported as unknown. Newly supplied ERP archive is supplementary until worker verification.
CLI-only --probe-erp-configuration purchase or inbound; no HTTP endpoint, host startup, private-file loading, new credentials or SSH. Existing environment connection and unchanged TLS policy only.
Fixed allowlisted SELECT projections only, row/time/byte caps, no dynamic SQL, configured SQL execution, stored procedures, DML/DDL, reservations, allocator calls, business reads or COMMIT.

Exclude account/customer/transaction rows, user/group permissions and secrets. No raw Source/Para/Filter/KeyValue/default expressions or full SQL bodies in output; only validated technical identifiers, booleans, lengths and SHA-256 fingerprints as applicable.
Report partial/missing/ambiguous/truncated mappings explicitly; metadata evidence does not confer action permissions, RuntimeAcceptance, runtimeQualified=true or production acceptance.
Do not modify ApiHost command defaults, factories, authentication/session/CSRF/security policies, frontend, schemas, dependencies, workflows or existing I55 probe contract.
Read-only live execution occurs only after root review, exact-head CI and approved deployment; no actual DB calls during preparation or CI.
Writer qualification remains a separate explicit checklist; existing purchase pilot Save/Submit still requires owner write approval and actual runtime evidence.
